name: school-carpool-rules-tests
description: Emulator tests for firestore.rules and storage.rules. Run through `npm run test:emulator` from this folder. One file at a time (--test-concurrency=1): the Storage emulator is shared by every file (clearStorage empties it for all of them) and its rules look up Firestore in the emulators' own project.

scripts.test:emulator: cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-school-carpool "npm --prefix tests/rules test"
